about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: You were matched because you both enjoy live music and gigs, and like similar weekends at the cinema. The app also chose them because they have the laid-back style you asked for.

how often.reply: You asked to meet every two weeks. You can check your mentor's details and how to get in touch on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

checklist.reply:
You have two tasks left on your [[Checklist]]: to join a society and to find a dentist. 

Since you're studying English, you might like the [[English]] society or the [[Book]] society since you enjoy reading.

who is my mentor.reply: Your mentor's name and how to get in touch are listed on your [[Your Mentor]] page. You can also check [[Find a mentor]] if you ever need to request one.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you are studying BA English Literature, you might enjoy [[English]] and [[Book]], which are great ways to meet people on your course and share your love of reading.

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply:
The mentoring coordinator is actually still finding a mentor for you by hand, so you haven't been matched just yet. 

Once they find someone for you, you'll be meeting weekly, and you can check [[Your Mentor]] for their details as soon as they're ready.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't been matched with a mentor yet because you haven't asked for one. If you'd like one, you can head over to [[Find a mentor]] to answer a few questions and get matched.
